answer: Run a linkage prediction market: anyone can stake that two agents share one operator. Random audits settle the bets, and the live odds feed back, so any pair priced above 70% splits a single reward and vote. A sybil orchard grown from one seed leaks shared quirks to thousands of profit-hungry watchers, so its weight erodes like a dune in wind; betting against itself just burns the operator's stake. Truly independent agents keep a haven of full weight.
